messages:
release-coord: Starting staged rollout of release v2026.04.01-concurrency. Kicking off canary at 5% in us-west-2. Change window 22:00-01:00 UTC. Please call stop/go within 20m.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:start service=runtime-proxy version=v2026.04.01-concurrency target_canary=5% region=us-west-2 cohort=canary-april01
``n
deploy id: rb-20260401-2200
started: 2026-04-01T22:00:12Z
targets: canary=5% (us-west-2)
notes: concurrency-tuning enabled: max_inflight=8 -> 12
```
nuke: observed. I'm watching p50/p95 and error budget. Ping me if p95 > 300ms or errors > 0.4%.
nana: QA smoke passed quick sanity suite, 0/120 failures so far. Ran on small sample.
nana: uploaded screenshots to /artifacts/qa/cc-401.
tanner: infra: autoscaler warmed but we saw a brief CPU bump on model-workers when inflight bumped to 12. Not critical yet.
deploy-bot: [METRICS] window=3m canary=5% rps=230 median_latency=95ms p95=310ms 5xx_rate=0.3% (baseline=0.12%) cpu_model_workers=78%
ops-bot: anomaly-detect: p95_exceed=1 (threshold=300ms) at 2026-04-01T22:04:58Z.
luke: p95 ticked over threshold in the last minute. Could be batching behaviour with higher inflight. If it stays ~310ms might be acceptable; if trending up we should halt.
release-coord: quick poll: hold and reduce inflight to 8, or continue and observe? react :thumbsup: reduce, :thumbsdown: continue. (5m)
nana: :thumbsup: reduce and retest.
tanner: :thumbsup: agree, prepping a quick tunable.
luke: :thumbsdown: if this flattens out we might be fine; suggestion: reduce to 10 instead of 8 to avoid thrash.
qa-bot: running extra smoke set on canary after change.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:pause service=runtime-proxy version=v2026.04.01-concurrency current_canary=5% reason=latency-p95-exceed
``n
operator: release-coord
```
ops-bot: changeplan: apply config max_inflight=10 for cohort=canary-april01, then resume at 5%.
release-coord: applying recommended middle-ground: set max_inflight=10, resume canary at 5% after a 60s warmup. Tanner, can you push the flag?
tanner: pushing flag now. ETA ~45s.
tanner: [ACTION] config:set service=runtime-proxy cohort=canary-april01 max_inflight=10
``n
apply id: cfg-20260401-001
status: in-progress
``
ops-bot: note: config change will rollout to canary nodes only. No rollback triggered yet.
qa-bot: smoke run queued after config change (id=smoke-cc-401-2).
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:resume service=runtime-proxy version=v2026.04.01-concurrency resumed_canary=5% warmup=60s
``n
resume id: rb-resume-20260401-2206
```
release-coord: monitoring. If p95 reduces below 300ms and 5xx stays <=0.4% for 10m we proceed to 20% bump. Call for stop if any new regressions.
ops-bot: metrics followup in 3m.
ops-bot: [METRICS] window=2m canary=5% median_latency=100ms p95=268ms 5xx=0.18% cpu_model_workers=69%
luke: looks stable and under threshold now.
nana: QA smoke: 0/240 failures. Regression set shows no new tokenizer diffs.
release-coord: consensus to proceed to 20%? react :thumbsup: proceed, :thumbsdown: hold for more checks. (3m)
luke: :thumbsup: proceed; ops to monitor.
tanner: :thumbsup: good to go.
nana: :thumbsup: ok from QA.
release-coord: bumping to 20% in us-west-2. Deploy bot will orchestrate.
deploy-bot: [ACTION] rollout:scale service=runtime-proxy version=v2026.04.01-concurrency from=5% to=20% region=us-west-2 step=scale-traffic
``n
scale id: rb-scale-20260401-2212
progress: 0->20% (staged over 2 minutes)
```
ops-bot: [METRICS] window=1m target=20% current=12% median_latency=110ms p95=290ms 5xx=0.27%
luke: slight rise in p95 but still under 300ms. Keep eyes on p95 and 5xx.
tanner: infra autoscale is spinning up additional model-workers, health checks passing.
qa-bot: scheduled regression run at 20% (id=reg-cc-401-20).
release-coord: OK team — we have a go to continue but call it if p95>300ms or 5xx>0.5% or any significant QA regressions. Posting brief to #release-notes: "v2026.04.01 canary scaled to 20% after tuning inflight to 10; monitoring ongoing."
luke: one last ask 16A: capture the config change in the changelog and tag owners for a follow-up perf study.
release-coord: noted. Will add in release notes and create a follow-up ticket. Thanks all. :shipit:
